content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Both Maintenance Engineer posts have the same structure: a degree route or a diploma route. The diploma must be in the branch of the post. For the diploma route of both engineer posts, the three years' experience must be from any of the following, as printed: CPWD / State PWD / Similar Organized Services Statutory or Autonomous Organizations Central / State Universities / Autonomous Institutions Working in State/Centre Government/Autonomous, directly or through private firms Working in a Private construction Company Candidates with experience of working in Central/State Government universities will be preferred. Qualification and experience are counted as on the date of interview, and eligibility will be decided at the time of interview. The upper age limit is 40 Years for Maintenance Engineer Civil and for Maintenance Engineer Electrical. The upper age limit is counted as on the date of interview. Reservations and relaxations for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWD/EWS candidates are as per the existing Govt. of India/UGC rules. However, an SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWD candidate who applies for an unreserved post will not be given any relaxation. Both engineer posts are UR.

rows.experience: One-year relevant experience with the degree; three years' experience in relevant field with the diploma

rows.qualification: Bachelor's Degree of Engineering/Technology in relevant field from a recognized Institute/University OR Diploma in Engineering (Electrical)
rows.experience: One-year relevant experience with the degree; three years' experience in relevant field with the diploma

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All posts are offered on a purely temporary and contractual basis. Selected candidates will not have any claim on regular position or absorption. Duties timing may be staggered and as decided by the university. Applicants are required to show the original documents at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUPB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application is online. Candidates must complete the online form before the last date. They must then attend the walk-in interview at the university on the date and time below. No separate call letters will be sent for the interview. Apply online through the recruitment portal www.cup.edu.in . Deposit the application fee of Rs. 100/- while filling the online form, on or before the last date. This fee applies to candidates other than SC/ST/PWD/Women. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWD/EWS candidates must upload the relevant certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India. Without it, the application shall be rejected. Upload the supporting enclosures, such as self-attested copies of degree, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificate. Incomplete applications may be rejected. Fill a separate application, with a separate application fee, for each post you apply for. Print the online application form by logging in to cupnt.samarth.edu.in. Report for the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 with the documents listed below. Interview venue: Central University of Punjab, Badal-Bathinda road, V.P.O.-Ghudda, District-Bathinda. Application fee: Rs. 100/- for candidates other than SC/ST/PWD/Women. The fee is paid while filling the online form. Application fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. Selection is by interview. If a large number of applicants appear for the interview, the University may shortlist the candidates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: For all posts, bring the following original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies to the interview: Printed copy of the online application form. Original certificates of Educational/Professional qualifications (Certificate/Degree + Mark sheets), and original experience certificates showing designation and period of service. Original appointment letters and pay slips, if applicable. Certificate of the last pay drawn, if applicable. Copies of testimonials or recommendation letters from previous or present employer(s), if any. Original caste certificate for reserved categories, if applicable. OBC and EWS candidates need a valid OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate for Govt. of India posts, issued on/after 01.04.2026. No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if you have not applied through proper channel or have changed your employer. Two passport size photographs. AADHAR Card. Any other documents required to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: Maintenance Engineer Civil (01-UR), Maintenance Engineer Electrical (01-UR) and Contractual Faculty (Self-Finance) for B.Pharmacy (02).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 30.11.2026 (10.00AM). Reporting for the walk-in interview is at 09:00AM on the same day.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the CUPB Maintenance Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree of Engineering/Technology in a relevant field with one-year relevant experience. Alternatively, they need a Diploma in Engineering (Civil or Electrical, as per the post) with three years' experience in a relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CUPB Maintenance Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 Years for both Maintenance Engineer posts, counted as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a CUPB Maintenance Engineer?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 55,000/- for Maintenance Engineer Civil and for Maintenance Engineer Electrical.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for candidates other than SC/ST/PWD/Women. It is paid while filling the online form and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in/ by 30.11.2026 (10.00AM). Then attend the walk-in interview at Central University of Punjab, Badal-Bathinda road, V.P.O.-Ghudda, District-Bathinda, with the printed form and original documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview, and eligibility is decided at the time of interview. If a large number of applicants appear, the University may shortlist the candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Are the CUPB Maintenance Engineer posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and contractual, for 1 Year, further extended as per the decision of the University. Candidates will not have any claim on regular position or absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application, with a separate application fee, must be filled for each post applied for.
